name: wordmark assembles into end card with CTA
looks: A small ribbon-shaped mark floats alone on a light field, then the full wordmark builds out beside it, a tagline with one italic accent word settles underneath, and a rounded CTA button fades up with the destination URL, with a row of small platform labels below.
build: wordmark-assemble: the mark settles first on a short spring, then letters build in from a tight cluster around it; the tagline reveals with a clipPath wipe; the CTA button scales up from 0.9 to 1 on back.out with its label types on.
sound: A soft chime as the mark settles, a swell under the wordmark build, a soft click on the CTA's arrival.
prompt: Close on a small brand mark settling alone, then build the full name out from it, with a short tagline underneath carrying one accent word in italic. Fade up a rounded call-to-action button with the destination, and list the platforms it is available on in a thin row beneath.
